result.summary: The pedestrian environment is dominated by a wide roadway with tram tracks and lacks basic safety infrastructure such as marked crosswalks or physical separation from vehicles. The presence of a long blank warehouse wall and the absence of street trees or buffers create a desolate and potentially hazardous space for walking.

hazards.name: Tram tracks
hazards.description: Exposed tracks in the roadway present a significant tripping hazard for pedestrians and a slip/fall risk for cyclists.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the roadway extending into the distance

hazards.name: Lack of vertical separation
hazards.description: The absence of curbs or physical barriers between the walkway and the travel lanes allows vehicles to easily encroach on pedestrian space.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the image where the warehouse meets the road

hazards.name: Blank frontage
hazards.description: The long, windowless wall of the construction supply building reduces passive surveillance and creates a monotonous, uninviting environment.
hazards.location_in_image: Left foreground and midground

interventions.title: Install Raised Curbs and Buffers
interventions.description: Introduce a raised curb and a planting strip or furniture zone to physically separate pedestrians from the roadway and tram tracks.

interventions.title: Marked Pedestrian Crossings
interventions.description: Add high-visibility crosswalks to provide designated and safer points for pedestrians to cross the wide roadway.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Greenery
interventions.description: Plant street trees to provide shade, improve the aesthetic quality of the industrial area, and act as a natural buffer.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is characterized by a degraded sidewalk in poor condition adjacent to a large vacant lot. There is a lack of formal crossing infrastructure, no visible curb separation from the roadway, and significant blank frontage that reduces natural surveillance.

hazards.name: Degraded Walkway Surface
hazards.description: The sidewalk is cracked with significant weed growth, creating tripping hazards and uneven footing.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground walkway along the bottom of the frame

hazards.name: Lack of Vertical Separation
hazards.description: There is no raised curb or physical barrier separating the pedestrian walkway from the active roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Transition between the asphalt road and the concrete walkway

hazards.name: Blank Frontage
hazards.description: The large vacant lot creates a lack of natural surveillance and 'eyes on the street', which can impact perceived and actual safety.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the image, the fenced vacant lot

interventions.title: Sidewalk Reconstruction
interventions.description: Repair and repave the sidewalk to provide a smooth, accessible surface for all users.

interventions.title: Curb Installation
interventions.description: Install a standard raised curb to provide vertical separation and protection from vehicle traffic.

interventions.title: Streetscape Improvements
interventions.description: Add street lighting and street trees to improve visibility, comfort, and the overall pedestrian experience.

result.summary: The street features a wide roadway with embedded tram tracks and sidewalks on both sides, though the environment lacks formal pedestrian crossings. A large commercial vehicle parked on the right creates a significant visual obstruction, while the left side presents a more open, less defined street edge.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Large Vehicle
hazards.description: A large truck parked on the right side of the street significantly blocks sightlines between pedestrians on the sidewalk and oncoming traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the roadway

hazards.name: Embedded Tram Tracks
hazards.description: Metal tracks in the roadway can be slippery when wet and pose a tripping hazard or a risk for bicycle tires.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the roadway

hazards.name: Lack of Marked Crossings
hazards.description: There are no designated or marked areas for pedestrians to cross this wide street safely.
hazards.location_in_image: Entire visible roadway

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks at intersections to define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Implement bulb-outs at corners to reduce crossing distance and improve visibility by moving pedestrians past the line of parked vehicles.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to intersections or potential crossing points to ensure clear sightlines.

result.summary: The environment is highly industrial and hostile to pedestrians, featuring a wide, degraded paved area that functions as a continuous driveway and loading zone. There is no physical separation between the walkway and the roadway, and the frontage consists of blank warehouse walls with stored construction materials.

hazards.name: Lack of pedestrian-vehicle separation
hazards.description: The entire walkway area is flush with the roadway and serves as a continuous vehicle access point for industrial loading.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground and mid-ground across the entire width of the paved area

hazards.name: Degraded pavement
hazards.description: Significant cracking and uneven surfaces create tripping hazards for pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground pavement surface

interventions.title: Raised Sidewalk and Curbing
interventions.description: Install a raised sidewalk with a vertical curb to clearly define and protect the pedestrian zone from vehicle loading areas.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Install street lighting to improve visibility and safety in this industrial corridor.

interventions.title: Pavement Rehabilitation
interventions.description: Resurface the walkway to remove tripping hazards and improve accessibility.
